headline: Air India losses top ₹22,000 crore amid high fuel costs and rerouted flights
summary: Air India recorded annual losses exceeding ₹22,000 crore, driven by elevated jet fuel prices and operational detours resulting from ongoing restrictions on Pakistani airspace.
why: Air India is one of South Asia's largest international carriers, operating long-haul international and domestic routes under Tata Group ownership.

impacts.name: Air India
impacts.why: Rising operational expenses and airspace detours expanded annual corporate losses.
